caption: The drawing depicts a single figurine seen from behind and slightly to the side, positioned toward the bottom left of the composition, leaving a large area of empty off-white space above and to the right. The figurine appears to be a woman with dark brown skin, dressed in a long, blue dress with lighter blue highlights and shading, and wearing an apron with tied strings at the back. The figure's hands are placed on her hips. She has a red headscarf with white dots tied around her head. The overall coloring uses shadows and highlights to define the form and folds of the dress, with the main colors being blue for the clothing, red and white for the headscarf, brown for the skin, and beige for the background. The paper shows slight discoloration and small marks or smudges, mainly in the right-hand section of the drawing.
title: Cast Iron Coin Bank
